protocol.forecast_source: Exact initialized runs already cached; no new downloads

feature_definitions.rain_onset: first wet forecast interval end, 1..36; 37 if no wet interval
feature_definitions.freezing_crossing: change between temperature < 0 C and >= 0 C in adjacent forecast hours
feature_definitions.heavy_hour: forecast liquid rain plus showers >= 2 mm/hour (descriptive threshold)

selection_rule: 2025 validation top-20 precision, then average precision, then lower Brier score

previous_forecast_v1.method: Paired resampling of calendar-week blocks; descriptive interval, not an independence guarantee

matched_history_v2.method: Paired resampling of calendar-week blocks; descriptive interval, not an independence guarantee

current_backend.method: Paired resampling of calendar-week blocks; descriptive interval, not an independence guarantee

limitations: 2026 results were inspected before this experiment; this is a development comparison, not a fresh final test.
Only two weather points serve 604 grids; LiDAR is not included in this experiment.
Targets are reported drainage concerns, not confirmed flooding; missing reports do not establish safety.
Daily 36-hour target windows overlap and six archive dates remain excluded.
Report publication delay is assumed to be 24 hours; forecast publication and ingestion completeness are unaudited.
Retrospective ERA5 past rainfall may differ from as-issued observations.
Calibration covers July-September 2025; probabilities may shift with season.
Matched history uses forecast-selected settings; it has not been independently tuned.
Neither an 80-90% event detection rate nor arbitrary-hour operation has been established.
